title: Why do smart people both make the worse choice? 🤝
description:
The prisoner's dilemma in under a minute: why two people acting rationally can both end up worse off, why price wars happen, and the simple strategy that won a 1980 computer tournament (tit for tat).

Sources:
https://www.econlib.org/library/Enc/PrisonersDilemma.html
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/?p=141634
https://praxis.ac.in/tit-for-tat-how-a-1980-game-theory-experiment-proved-co-operation-triumphs-above-all/

humour.trend: 'W chews / L nibbles' food-rating videos (KYM weekly roundup, 2026-11-06), as a text card

speaker: ved

The logic: *W chews*.
The result: *L nibbles*.

scenes.say: The way out? Repeat the game. In a *1980* computer tournament, the winner was simple:
be nice first, then *copy* whatever the other player did last.
